verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Reset behavior: HRESETn active LOW + first transfer no earlier than next rising HCLK after HRESETn=HIGH.
Single SINGLE transfer (read + write).
Incrementing bursts INCR4 / INCR8 / INCR16 (aligned, max-length, last beat is SEQ).
Wrapping bursts WRAP4 / WRAP8 / WRAP16 with HSIZE coverage Byte/Halfword/Word/Doubleword.
Undefined-length INCR with NONSEQ/SEQ/BUSY mid-burst.
1KB burst boundary enforcement (incrementing bursts).
IDLE + BUSY zero-wait OKAY response by Subordinates.
BUSY transfer mid-burst (undefined-length only at end).
Subordinate-driven wait states (HREADYOUT=0 for N cycles).
Address-phase constraints during waited transfers (Section 3.7).
Two-cycle ERROR response (Manager continue + Manager abort with HTRANS=IDLE).
Locked sequence (HMASTLOCK=1) — read+write to same Subordinate region.
Locked sequence followed by recommended IDLE.
HPROT 4-bit basic encoding (Data/Inst, User/Privileged, Bufferable, Modifiable).
HPROT 7-bit extended memory types (Device-nE/E, Normal NC, Write-through, Write-back, Shareable).
Default Subordinate ERROR response for unmapped addresses.
AHB5 Secure transfers (HNONSEC) — constancy across burst.
AHB5 Exclusive transfers (HEXCL, HMASTER, HEXOKAY) with monitor invalidation.
AHB5 Write strobes HWSTRB sparse-write byte-lane coverage.
AHB5 User signaling HxUSER (point-to-point only).
AHB5 Interface protection using parity — single-bit fault injection on each interface.
Multi-Manager arbitration (multi-layer AHB, via interconnect).
Reset behavior: PRESETn active LOW + first SETUP no earlier than next rising PCLK after PRESETn=HIGH.
Write transfer with no wait states (SETUP -> ACCESS -> IDLE).
Write transfer with wait states (PREADY=0 for N cycles; all bridge outputs stable).
Read transfer with no wait states.
Read transfer with wait states.
Failing write transfer with PSLVERR=1 in cycle PREADY=1.
Failing read transfer with PSLVERR=1 (PRDATA may be invalid).
PSLVERR valid-window enforcement (only valid when PSEL=PENABLE=PREADY=1).
PSLVERR-optional peripheral (PSLVERR input tied LOW at bridge).
Fixed-2-cycle peripheral (PREADY tied HIGH).
PSEL mutual exclusion across multiple Subordinates.
APB4 PSTRB sparse-write byte-lane coverage.
APB4 PSTRB=all-zero on reads.
APB4 PPROT encoding (normal/privileged, secure/nonsecure, data/instruction).
APB4 PPROT constancy during PREADY=0 wait states.
AHB-to-APB bridge: PSLVERR -> HRESP=ERROR mapping (two-cycle).
AXI-to-APB bridge: PSLVERR -> RRESP/BRESP=SLVERR mapping.
interoperability_test_matrix: AHB-Lite Manager + AHB5 Subordinate (AHB5 optional signals at safe defaults).
AHB5 Manager + AHB-Lite Subordinate (Manager ignores HEXOKAY etc.).
AHB Manager with Write_Strobes=True interfaced to Subordinate with Write_Strobes=False (HWSTRB tied HIGH at Subordinate).
APB2 peripheral on an APB3/APB4 bridge (PREADY tied HIGH, PSLVERR tied LOW).
APB3 peripheral on an APB4 bridge (PPROT + PSTRB ignored).
End-to-end: AXI Manager -> AHB-Lite Subordinate (via AXI-to-AHB bridge) -> AHB-to-APB bridge -> APB peripheral; error responses propagate end-to-end.
fields.notes: Neither AHB IHI 0033C nor APB IHI 0024C provides a formal verification plan; the categories above are derived from Chapters 3 (Transfers), 4 (Bus Interconnection), 5 (Subordinate Response Signaling), 10 (Exclusive Transfers), 12 (Interface protection) of AHB, and Chapter 3 (Transfers) + Chapter 4 (Operating States) of APB.
